title: This Is..., That Is...: Ez, Az

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Ez (this) and az (that) can stand alone as the subject of a sentence, identifying something with no verb needed in the third person.
Ez a zöldség and Az a gyümölcs both drop van — Hungarian never says 'Ez van a zöldség'. The definite article a/az still appears before the noun even though ez/az already points at it.
